front: Where are Zimbabwe's main pine and eucalyptus plantations?
back: In the Eastern Highlands (Nyanga, Chimanimani, Penhalonga).

front: Which trees form the natural forests of the Kalahari sands?

front: Which woodland covers much of the central plateau?
back: Miombo woodland, dominated by msasa and munhondo.
